definition_en: the whole physical structure of a person or animal
scene: 清晨他站在镜子前活动身体。He stretched his whole body before running.
sceneCN: 这里 body 是「身体」（第 1 个义项：人或动物的整个躯体）；句意是跑步前他伸展了整个身体。

senses.title: The physical form of a person
senses.definition: the whole physical structure of a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 人或动物完整的躯体结构
senses.example: He stretched his whole body before running.
senses.exampleCN: 跑步前他伸展了整个身体。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, naming the trunk and then the whole living form.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，先指躯干，后指整个活着的躯体。

senses.title: A dead person
senses.definition: the dead body of a person
senses.example: The police found a body in the river.
senses.exampleCN: 警方在河里发现了一具尸体。
senses.why: A corpse is still a body, so the same word serves for the dead.
senses.whyCN: 尸体仍然是一具躯体，所以同一个词也用来指死者。

senses.title: The main part
senses.definition: the main or central part of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物最主要或居中的部分
senses.example: The body of the report is only ten pages.
senses.why: A trunk is the main part of a tree, and the word spread to texts and groups.
senses.whyCN: 树干是树的主体，这个词便扩展到文本与团体。

intro.en: Body is an Old English word for the trunk, later widened to the whole person.
intro.cn: body 是古英语中指躯干的词，后来扩展到整个人。

items.en: bodig meant the trunk or chest of a person.
items.cn: bodig 指人的躯干或胸腔。

items.en: body widened from the trunk to the whole living form.
items.cn: body 从躯干扩展到整个活着的躯体。

items.en: body was also used for a corpse.
items.cn: body 也开始用来指尸体。

items.en: body of water and body of law named main wholes.
items.cn: body of water 与 body of law 用来指一个整体。

items.en: body covers the physical form, a corpse and the main part.
items.cn: 如今 body 兼指躯体、尸体与主体。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the b-o-d shape; the near-meaning group names forms and corpses.
note.cn: 形近组共有 b-o-d 的字母形状；近义组指身形与尸体。

entries.definition: to be a sign of something
the shape of a person's body
the main part of a body

normalIntro.en: Body is the whole form you can touch, from head to feet.
normalIntro.cn: body 是从头到脚、能够触摸到的整个躯体。

normal.en: Body and bodies are the singular and plural.
normal.cn: 单数是 body，复数是 bodies。

normal.en: The body of a letter is its main part.
normal.cn: 信件的 body 指正文部分。

normal.en: Body language shows feeling without words.
normal.cn: body language 指不用言语表达情绪的肢体动作。
bodyguard 指保护他人的保镖。

normal.en: Bodily means related to the body.
normal.cn: bodily 意为与身体有关的。

abstract.en: See yourself in a full mirror.
abstract.cn: 想象自己站在一面全身镜前。

abstract.en: See a wide river as one body of water.
abstract.cn: 想象一条宽阔的河作为一片水域。

abstract.en: See a report with a short main body.
abstract.cn: 想象一份主体很短的报告。

examples.en: He stretched his whole body before running.
examples.cn: 跑步前他伸展了整个身体。

examples.en: The police found a body in the river.
examples.cn: 警方在河里发现了一具尸体。

examples.en: The body of the report is only ten pages.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 bo 想成「拨」，dy 想成「动」：身体一拨就动，body 就是身体。

root: body 源自古英语 bodig，本指人的躯干或胸腔，后来扩展到整个人体，又发展出「尸体」与「主体」的意思。

sensesIntro.en: The physical form, a dead body and the main part of something.
sensesIntro.cn: 活着的躯体、死后的尸体，以及事物的主体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person stretching in front of a mirror.
core.cn: 核心意象：镜前伸展身体的人。

intro.en: Body forms compounds and a few derived words.
intro.cn: body 可以构成复合词和少量派生词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Old English; the Latin items below are related only in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自古英语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

items.meaning: to give a visible form to
the main part of a body
